observations: Photo 0 shows a black Nikon DSLR camera with a lens attached, held in hand. The camera body has 'Nikon' and 'D5300' clearly visible. The lens has 'Nikon AF-S DX NIKKOR 18-55mm 1:3.5-5.6G VR' engraved on it.
Photo 1 shows the back of the camera with a label that reads 'Nikon DIGITAL CAMERA D5300', 'MADE IN THAILAND', 'Nikon Corp. Japan', and '20457/53'. The label also shows FCC and CE marks.

Photo 2 shows the top of the camera with the lens attached. The lens barrel has 'Nikon DX VR' and 'AF-S NIKKOR 18-55mm 1:3.5-5.6G' visible. The camera has a mode dial, power button, and Wi-Fi button. A strap is attached.
All photos show a watermark 'MCSTEVE POSTED ON JIJI'.
The camera appears to be in used condition with some dust and minor wear visible on the lens and body.

risks.risk: Lens may have internal damage or scratches not visible in photos
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the lens front element and rear element, or a video showing the lens being rotated and the glass surfaces inspected.

risks.proof: A video showing the camera being operated through full range of functions, including zooming and focusing.
